an1.616:1.1: vaggo sattamo. [8. amatavaggo] 1. 16. 8. 1-8. amataṃ te bhikkhave na paribhuñjanti, ye kāyagatāsatiṃ na paribhuñjanti.
an1.616:1.2: amataṃ te bhikkhave paribhuñjanti, ye kāyagatāsatiṃ paribhuñjanti.
an1.617:1.1: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave aparibhuttaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparibhuttā.
an1.617:1.2: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave paribhuttaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati paribhuttāti.
an1.618:1.1: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave parihīnaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati parihīnā.
an1.618:1.2: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave aparihīnaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparihīnā.
an1.619:1.1: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave viraddhaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati viraddhā.
an1.619:1.2: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave āraddhaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati āraddhā.
an1.620:1.1: amataṃ te bhikkhave pamādiṃsu, ye kāyagatāsatiṃ pamādiṃsu.
an1.620:1.2: amataṃ te bhikkhave nappamādiṃsu, ye kāyagatāsatiṃ nappamādiṃsu.
an1.621:1.1: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave pammuṭṭhaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati pammuṭṭhā.
an1.621:1.2: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave apammuṭṭhaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati apammuṭṭhāti.
an1.622:1.1: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave anāsevitaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati anāsevitā.
an1.622:1.2: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave āsevitaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati āsevitā.
an1.623:1.1: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave abhāvitaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abhāvitā.
an1.623:1.2: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave bhāvitaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati bhāvitā.
an1.624:1.1: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave abahulīkataṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abahulīkatā.
an1.624:1.2: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave bahulīkataṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati bahulīkatā.
an1.625:1.1: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave anabhiññātaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati anabhiññātā.
an1.625:1.2: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave abhiññātaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abhiññātā.
an1.626:1.1: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave apariññātaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati apariññātā.
an1.626:1.2: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave pariññātaṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati pariññātā.
an1.627:1.1: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave asacchikataṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati asacchikatā.
an1.627:1.2: amataṃ tesaṃ bhikkhave sacchikataṃ, yesaṃ kāyagatāsati sacchikatāti.
